comment: Which host-specific profiles check_repo_wiki_converge.py runs on top of its core checks.
Core is everything the module can prove about itself: upstream purity, prompt verbatimness,
post-pass selftests, and the three subagent read boundaries. Those run everywhere.
A profile asserts something about the HOST this copy is installed in, so a copy dropped into
another repo declares an empty list and still gets a real gate.
This file must exist. A missing or unparseable declaration is FATAL (exit 3), never a silent
skip: 'nobody configured it' must not be readable as 'this host has no such profile'.
Unknown profile names are FATAL for the same reason -- a typo would otherwise disable a check
repodoc              -- the indexing/ KB sink: RepoDoc frontmatter contract + dry-run ingest
host-skill-links     -- the host exposes this skill as a symlink into the module, not a copy
skill-bettor-layout  -- source-repo directory conventions: repo//prototype/ scaffolders,
SKILL_BETTOR_* env names, the retirement commit pin
bettor-arena declares host-skill-links only. It has no indexing/ KB sink (repodoc) and does
not carry the skill-bettor repo//prototype/ working-directory conventions (skill-bettor-layout);
declaring either here would make the gate assert host facts that are false in this checkout.
